units.source_text: “有些女子，相貌不恶，年方青春，洁身自好，一尘不染；

en.t: Some women are not at all unattractive, are still in the bloom of youth, and keep themselves pure and untouched by any stain;

units.source_text: 写信措辞温雅，墨色浓淡适度。

en.t: when they write letters, their wording is gentle and refined, and even the light and dark tones of the ink are perfectly measured.

units.source_text: 受信的男子被弄得魂牵梦萦，于是再度致书，希望清楚地见到她。

en.t: The man who receives such a letter is left utterly captivated, so he writes again, hoping to see her clearly for himself.
After waiting in restless longing, he finally manages to meet her.

units.source_text: 隔着帘帷，遥寄相思，但也只是微闻娇音，听得三言两语而已。

en.t: Separated by curtains and screens, they exchange their longing from afar, yet all he can do is faintly hear her charming voice and catch a few brief words.

units.source_text: 这种女子，最善于隐藏缺点。

en.t: Women like this are especially skilled at hiding their faults.

units.source_text: 然而在男子看来，这真是个窈窕淑女，就一意钟情，热诚求爱，

en.t: Yet to the man she appears to be a truly graceful and virtuous lady, so he gives his heart to her alone and pursues her with passionate devotion,

units.source_text: 却不道这是个轻薄女子！

en.t: never realizing that she is in fact a frivolous woman!
This is the first great difficulty in choosing a partner.
